name: Ping An Biomedical Co., Ltd.

profile.description: Ping An Biomedical Co., Ltd., formerly Majestic Ideal Holdings Ltd. (name changed September 2025), provides supply chain management services in the apparel industry in China, Hong Kong, Cambodia, and Europe. Services include market trend analysis, product design and development, raw material sourcing, production and quality control, and logistics management. The company also engages in manufacturing and trading of yarns, textiles, and finished garments, real estate property investment, and warehousing services. Founded in 2013 and listed on NASDAQ Capital Market.

Revenue collapsed 61% to $34.15M in FY2025, suggesting business contraction, not innovation. AI Deployment (0/2): No evidence of any AI products, services, or internal AI deployment. ai_resilience.label: MODERATE
ai_resilience.analysis: AI Risk Protection (5/9): The company's stated business of apparel supply chain management — sourcing, production, quality control, and logistics — faces moderate AI exposure [1]. AI-powered supply chain optimization, automated quality inspection, and demand forecasting tools could partially displace the sourcing and logistics coordination services that PASW provides. However, the physical aspects of textile manufacturing, garment production in facilities across China and Cambodia, and hands-on quality control provide some structural protection against full AI substitution. The company's pivot toward 'Biomedical' is too undefined to assess AI resilience in any potential new business line. AI Opportunity (0/1): No AI products, services, or revenue identified. The company shows no evidence of adopting or deploying AI in any capacity.

infinite_game.summary: Ping An Biomedical exhibits no characteristics of an infinite game player. The company has no articulated Just Cause, no evidence of courageous leadership decisions, no organizational culture data, no strategic flexibility beyond a superficial name change, and no competitive mindset beyond survival. With 7 employees, collapsing revenue, and a cosmetic rebrand, this appears to be a company in terminal decline or transitioning toward a shell structure.

Seven employees and collapsing revenue indicate a company in survival mode, not purpose-driven mode.

investment_thesis: There is no credible bull case for PASW. The company has 7 employees, a $19.93M market cap, and TTM revenue of just $4.8M after a 61% revenue collapse in FY2025 [1]. The September 2025 name change from Majestic Ideal Holdings (a textile supply chain company) to Ping An Biomedical has not been accompanied by any visible biomedical operations, products, or capabilities. The stock trades at $0.16 per share with daily dollar volume of approximately $29,000 — far below institutional investability thresholds.
thesis_continued: PASW fails every IOWN quality screen. The stock triggers the liquidity floor ($29K daily dollar volume vs. $1M minimum), rendering it untradeable for any meaningful position size [1]. The company is unprofitable (EPS of -$0.10), has no dividend, no visible product pipeline, and no competitive moat. The name change to 'Biomedical' without any biomedical substance raises concerns about corporate governance and strategic direction. With no mission, no R&D, no AI capabilities, and 7 employees operating a shrinking apparel supply chain from Hong Kong, this is effectively a shell company. Any capital deployed here faces near-total loss risk with no identifiable path to value creation.
